_help: The one small file for homepage choices. Everything here is optional. Use an item's id: building:<slug>, writing:<slug> or video:<YouTube id>.
_featured_help: Set to an id to feature that item on the homepage. Leave null and the newest full-length video is featured automatically.
_homeProjects_help: Up to three project ids for the homepage. Leave empty and the first three projects with a page and a picture are used, in the order of the project list.
_hide_help: Ids listed here never appear in homepage or featured areas. Their pages and archive entries stay exactly as they are.
_corrections_help: Only for videos, whose details come from YouTube. Example: {"video:abc123def45": {"title": "A better title", "thumbnail": "video/my-picture.webp"}}. Projects and writing are corrected in their own record.
